text: Fertilizer is applied in stages rather than all at once: a basal application worked into the bed before transplanting, followed by top-dressings timed to vine growth, flowering, and fruit-set/fruit-enlargement stages. The staged approach is meant to match nutrient supply to the plant's changing demand through its roughly 65-70 day cycle.
caveat: Specific N-P-K ratios and gram-per-plant amounts for muskmelon were not reliably legible in this scan (unlike the cucumber source, where the fertigation table was clean); treat exact rates as unconfirmed pending a cleaner re-read of this source.
